Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely selected Peter Bjorn and John as the “performer of Falling Out” based on an incorrect rationale (“earliest album,” misstating the year and overlooking Serena Ryder’s 1999 album). This led to conflating a band’s “origin” (Stockholm) with a performer’s “birthplace,” deviating from the earlier plan to systematically compare candidates. As a result, the Planner pursued Stockholm and “Stockholm Palace,” likely yielding the wrong castle (instead of, for example, Serena Ryder’s birthplace Toronto and Casa Loma).
